Ownership and source comparisons

Baseplate owns placement, permissions, formatting, saved overrides and editor draft/Save behavior. Templ emits semantic slots without baked layout utilities. These references add no chart runtime, widget registry or persistence.

See the contract and issue #23 for pinned producer sources and verification boundaries.
